newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - April 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Caloocan city incumbent mayor Reynaldo Malonzo led challenger Macario Asistio Jr by a wide margin based in early unofficial returns in the Caloocan City recall election yesterday. (MANILA CHRONICLE,THE PHILIPPINE STAR,TODAY,MANILA STANDARD)

- The plan to amend the Constitution and lift term limits on President Ramos and other elected officials was mapped out in Malacanang, former Commission on election chairman Christian Monsod said. (PHILIPPINE DAILY INQUIRER)

- Oil refiner Petron Corp said on Wednesday it is set to increase on April 11 the domestic pump prices of its petroleum products. In a statement, Petron said retail price of premium gasoline would be raised by 40 centavos to 11.67 pesos per litre, while unleaded premium would be increased by 40 centavos to 11.28 pesos per litre. (BUSINESSWORLD, BUSINESS DAILY)
- The Philippine Central Bank said the country's net foreign investments dropped by 34.43 percent to $1.055 billion in 1996 compared to the previous year's $1.609 billion. (MANILA CHRONICLE)
- The Manila Electric Co has reduced rates by an average of 70 centavos per kilowatt hour. (MALAYA)
